question: According to the Centre for Monitoring Indian Economy (CMIE), in which state of India was the unemployment rate recorded as 0.1%, as of September 2022?
solution:
The correct answer is **__Chhattisgarh__**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• As a result of** increased labor force participation** in both **rural and urban areas**,** India's unemployment rate** has significantly **decreased**, reaching** 6.43 percent** in **September 2022**, according to data from the** Centre for Monitoring Indian Economy (CMIE)**.
 
• As employment plummeted by **2 million to 394.6 million** in **August**, India's jobless rate shot up to a **one-year high of 8.3%**.
 
• **The highest unemployment rate **in September, according to CMIE data, was recorded in **Rajasthan (23.8%)**, followed by **Jammu & Kashmir (23.2%)**, **Haryana (22.9%)**, **Tripura (17%), Jharkhand (12.2%)**, and** Bihar (11.4%)**.
 
• With a rate of** 0.1%** in September, **Chhattisgarh had the lowest unemployment rate**, followed by **Assam (0.4%), Uttrakhand (0.5%), Madhya Pradesh (0.9%), Gujarat (1.6%), Meghalaya (2.3%),** and **Odisha (2.9%)**.
 
• August saw a **sharp rise** in both the **urban and rural jobless rates**, reaching **9.6% and 7.7%**, respectively.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Centre for Monitoring Indian Economy (CMIE):**

 
 
• The Center for Monitoring Indian Economy (CMIE) is an independent economic research organization based in Mumbai, India.
 
• CMIE provides data, analysis, and research on various aspects of the Indian economy, including macroeconomic indicators, industry trends, and consumer sentiment.
 
• The organization conducts regular surveys and collects data on employment, income, and consumption patterns in India.
 
• CMIE's data and analysis are widely used by policymakers, businesses, and researchers to understand and track economic trends in India.
 
• The organization also offers subscription-based services for access to its database and research reports.
